WinDV 2.1 finishes the to-do list the original author, Petr Mourek, left on his website: safer captures when the disk fills up or the tape runs out.

## Download

- **WinDV-2.1.0-x64.zip**: for 64-bit Windows (almost every PC).
- **WinDV-2.1.0-x86.zip**: for 32-bit Windows.

Unzip anywhere and run `WinDV.exe`. Nothing needs installing. Requires Windows 10 or 11. Your settings from WinDV 2.0 (or the original WinDV) carry over.

## What's new

- **Free disk space**: the capture tab shows how much space is left where captures are saved, and roughly how many hours of DV fit. WinDV won't start a capture with less than 256 MB free. If the disk fills up during a capture, WinDV stops just before it's full and saves the file properly instead of leaving it broken.
- **Stop at the end of the tape** (optional): turn on *Settings > Stop when the signal ends*, and a capture finishes by itself once no video has arrived for the number of seconds you choose. Leave it off if your tapes have blank gaps between recordings.
- **Write errors are no longer ignored**: if a capture file can't be written (a full or unplugged drive), WinDV stops, tells you what happened, and keeps what was captured so far.
- **Only DV camcorders are listed**: webcams and other video sources no longer appear in the camcorder list.
- The status bar says why a capture ended: the set duration was reached, the signal ended, or the disk was nearly full.

## Thanks

WinDV was created by Petr Mourek (2002-2003, http://windv.mourek.cz), who generously shared its source. This release completes the items he had planned for it.
